Hi Evelyn / Grace,

Quick note — our VP of Engineering (Alex Morales) just got an updated travel itinerary and will be landing later than expected on Wednesday. He was planning to join the 3:00 PM demo window and is asking if we can either push the session by 90 minutes or move it to Thursday morning. Tom and I want to keep the technical walkthrough with the exec sponsor in the room if possible.

We know this is late; apologies for the churn. Can you share any short windows tomorrow (Thu) morning or a later Wed slot that still gives us 60–75 minutes with your team?

Attaching the current MAP and a brief system diagram in case that helps with internal triage.

Thanks — Patricia

- Thu 9:00–10:15 AM PT (full 75m walkthrough, can include deep-dive with engineering)

Karthik / Grace — can one of you take lead on the Wed late slot if Borealis wants to keep it the same day? If not, we'll pencil Thu 9:00.

Patricia — which option works best on your side?

Best,
